hero.first_text: I build web platforms end to end: interface, API, database and deployment.
hero.second_text: 3+ years shipping production systems for mining, the public sector and private clients.
hero.stack: React · Vue · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · AWS · Azure

card_info.my_description: I build complete web applications: clear interfaces, APIs and business logic, data modeling and cloud infrastructure. I take part from requirements gathering until the system is running in production.
card_info.skills_description: Management systems, SaaS platforms and integrations with external services such as payments, authentication or weather data. Maintainable code, built to grow.
card_info.ux_ui_description: A good application also has to be easy to use. I turn Figma designs into responsive, consistent and multilingual interfaces, taking care of the details of every interaction.
card_info.cloud_description: Deployment and operation on AWS, Azure or self-managed servers with Docker, with code quality reviewed through SonarQube.

experience.title: EXPERIENCE
experience.subtitle: (CAREER)
experience.description: Over three years building software, both in company teams and on my own projects.

consulting.description: Building custom platforms for clients across different industries, such as environmental management for mining and a sales and subscription system for a municipal club. I work on frontend, backend, integrations and cloud deployment.

water.description: Built well monitoring and water extraction data reporting systems for mining companies, rural water utilities and government agencies. Actively proposed improvements based on each client's needs.

internship.description: First step into professional development, working within a software team.

projects.title: (PROJECTS)
projects.description: A selection of systems I have worked on as a full stack developer, both at companies and independently. For confidentiality, company projects are shown without client names.

wells.title: Well Monitoring
wells.description: Platform to control and manage well monitoring points for mining companies and rural water utilities.

water_data.title: Water Extraction Reporting
water_data.description: System that transmits water extraction data from mining and rural utility wells to government agencies.

wildlife.title: Wildlife Relocation
wildlife.description: Management of endangered species that must be relocated before land can be used for mineral extraction. Integrates weather data from external services.

club.title: Municipal Club: Sales & Subscriptions
club.description: Management and sales of programs and activities for a municipal club: subscriptions, contracts, scholarships and gift cards, with Google and Microsoft sign-in.

pools.description: Client and pool maintenance management: per-pool records, workers, vehicles, inventory with stock alerts, sales, jobs, coatings and repairs.

encanto.description: System for an events venue: tables and orders, inventory, sales, staff working hours and event management with capacity and schedules. Includes a public site to buy tickets with Mercado Pago.

my_self.title: DEVELOPER
my_self.my_self_text: I turn real business needs into software people use every day.
my_self.about_me_description: I'm Gonzalo, I'm {{age}} and I live in Santiago, Chile. I'm a full stack developer with degrees in Software Development Engineering and Computer Programming Analysis, and over three years of professional experience.
my_self.about_me_description2: I have worked on systems for mining, public agencies, environmental management and commerce. I like to get involved beyond the code: understanding the business, proposing improvements and talking directly with clients to reach the right solution.

resolutive.title: Problem solver
resolutive.text: When something gets stuck, I find a way out: I research, test and propose alternatives before the problem grows.

committed.title: Committed
committed.text: I take ownership of what I build, from the first meeting until it runs in production, and after that too.

passionate.title: Passionate
passionate.text: I enjoy learning: I try new tools on my own projects before bringing them to work.

team.title: Team player
team.text: I explain technical topics in simple terms and work well with clients, designers and other developers.

my_self.availability: Open to opportunities and new development projects
